# synthesized: ClientHello-derived trace lines mention X25519MLKEM768
# but no ServerHello-derived line ever names a group. This shape is
# what the hybrid parser must reject per the scanner contract
# SKILL.md MVP policy rule #1 (`negotiated_group == "X25519MLKEM768"`
# AND `observation_type == NEGOTIATED`). Real `openssl s_client` does
# not emit ClientHello extensions in `-brief` mode; this fixture
# represents the shape `-trace` or a debug build would produce, and is
# used to prove the parser does not infer hybrid negotiation from
# offered groups alone.
